What every prophet taught

The trust we carry

The heavens and earth were made with truth. We were made to worship God, and we took up a trust.

Why are we here? The Quran says the heavens and earth were made with truth, not as a game. It tells of a trust offered to the heavens, earth and mountains. They shrank from it, and the human took it up, though we often fall short. It also says we were created to worship God. The two stand together. A small creature, with a great charge.

﴿وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَـَٔاتِيَةٌ ۖ فَٱصْفَحِ ٱلصَّفْحَ ٱلْجَمِيلَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And We have not created the heavens and earth and that between them except in truth. And indeed, the Hour is coming; so forgive with gracious forgiveness.

Quran · Al-Hijr 15:85

﴿إِنَّا عَرَضْنَا ٱلْأَمَانَةَ عَلَى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱلْجِبَالِ فَأَبَيْنَ أَن يَحْمِلْنَهَا وَأَشْفَقْنَ مِنْهَا وَحَمَلَهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ ظَلُومًا جَهُولًا﴾

Translation of the meaning

Indeed, We offered the Trust to the heavens and the earth and the mountains, and they declined to bear it and feared it; but man [undertook to] bear it. Indeed, he was unjust and ignorant.

Quran · Al-Ahzab 33:72

﴿وَمَا خَلَقْتُ ٱلْجِنَّ وَٱلْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.

Quran · Adh-Dhariyat 51:56

﴿ءَامِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَأَنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا جَعَلَكُم مُّسْتَخْلَفِينَ فِيهِ ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنكُمْ وَأَنفَقُوا۟ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Believe in Allāh and His Messenger and spend out of that in which He has made you successive inheritors. For those who have believed among you and spent, there will be a great reward.

Quran · Al-Hadid 57:7

You might ask

QuestionWhat is the trust?
AnswerThe verse does not spell it out. Commentators speak of duties taken on freely: a being able to obey or refuse, and answerable for the choice.Quran · Al-Ahzab 33:72
QuestionWhich is the aim, worship or the trust?
AnswerBoth stand in the Quran, and neither cancels the other. We were created to worship God, and we took up a trust. One life answers both.Quran · Adh-Dhariyat 51:56
QuestionWas I made for nothing?
AnswerThe Quran asks this itself: did you think We made you without purpose, and that you would not return to Us? Your life was meant.Quran · Al-Mu'minun 23:115

You were trusted with something great. Carry it, with God's help.
